about.title: About Me
about.body: I am Vinicius, 19, living in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. I build backend and web logic end to end — HTTP contracts, business rules, authn/authz, data — and I also read systems at a low level and security. Three axes of the day: serious technology, offensive and defensive cybersecurity, and Jewish halakha as a practical standard. I am not a one-tool niche: I design the service, harden it, and understand how it breaks.

pillars.craftBody: I start from how a program holds state, talks on the network, and defends itself. In backend and web logic I design APIs, data models, sessions/JWT as contracts, jobs, and observability. In C++20 and RE I work memory, binaries, and overlays that must stay stable under load. On offense I map real failures on endpoints and surface; on defense I close the same path with controls, integrity, and telemetry. I also read markets and chain. Grey-hat here means studying offense to design defense — not publishing recipes.
pillars.craftRepel: I design the service. I test it. I close it.
pillars.faithBody: In Santa Cruz de la Sierra, learning and the practice of halakha are not a footer. They are the other standard of the same day. Halakha sets the rhythm; the craft is measured with the same seriousness. בעזרת השם, כל עכבה לטובה — every delay is for the good.

work.title: Work

items.title: Backend and web logic
items.body: I design and ship backend: HTTP contracts, business rules, authentication and authorization, persistence, and clear layer boundaries. Web logic is not empty CRUD: it is the system that must be correct under load and under abuse.

items.title: API security
items.body: I review APIs and endpoints as attack and defense surface: authn/authz, poorly scoped objects, flow abuse, secrets, rate limits, and trust chains. I document the failure and the fix — not an exploitation playbook.

items.title: Offense and defense
items.body: Both sides of the same problem. Offense: surface, logic, and binaries to see where a system yields. Defense: controls, integrity, and telemetry so that path stops being usable. Blind defense does not work.

items.title: Fernet
items.body: C++20 tooling: Windows systems, high-performance overlays, and client integrity. On this site it is defense and stability research — not an offensive catalog.

items.title: Mercav.lat
items.body: CEO. The product lives at mercav.lat; here, the role and the link. The rest of the site speaks to the technical craft.

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: If you need someone who designs the service, hardens it, and understands how it breaks — we should talk. In earnest.
connect.shabbatNote: I reply after Shabbat. The profiles can be read; mail is not opened until Motzaei Shabbat.
connect.closing: Backend, web logic, low-level systems, and security: one profile that closes the loop. If we talk, we talk in earnest.

shabbat.title: Shabbat
shabbat.body: I am observing Shabbat. The work rests; so do I. I read messages after 6:30 p.m. Argentina time on Saturday.
